title: A positive tilt matches the Poisson denominator
target_statement: Let natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), including \(\kappa=4\). Put \(s=\sqrt\kappa\), \(r=(1-1/n)(s-1)/(s+1)\), and \(\ell=(4ns+(s-1)^2)/(8n(n-1))\). Then \(0<r<1\), \(\ell>0\), and \(\ell=(\kappa-1)(1+r^2)/(8r)-(\kappa+1)/4\). Moreover \((\kappa-1)/(2r)=n(s+1)^2/(2(n-1))\). For every real \(u\), \(\kappa+1+4\ell-(\kappa-1)u=((\kappa-1)/(2r))(1+r^2-2ru)=(n(s+1)^2/(2(n-1)))(1+r^2-2ru)\). These are scalar identities; the source applies them to its actual \(U=O_{11}\).
